findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the customer-managed key material is never automatically rotated, extending the blast radius of a compromised key (CIS AWS Foundations control on KMS key rotation).

No explicit policy is attached to the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full key access to the entire account root (effectively any IAM principal with KMS permissions). For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and permits broad decrypt/disable access.
